hebrewText: אֶזְכְּרָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְ/אֶֽהֱמָיָ֑ה אָשִׂ֓יחָה וְ/תִתְעַטֵּ֖ף רוּחִ֣/י סֶֽלָה

tokens.bdb: properly, to mark (so as to be recognized), i.e. to remember; by implication, to mention;  to be male
tokens.kjv: [idiom] burn (incense), [idiom] earnestly, be male, (make) mention (of), be mindful, recount, record(-er), remember, make to be remembered, bring (call, come, keep, put) to (in) remembrance, [idiom] still, think on, [idiom] well.

tokens.bdb: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
tokens.kjv: angels, [idiom] exceeding, God (gods) (-dess, -ly), [idiom] (very) great, judges, [idiom] mighty.
tokens.enLiteralWord: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus
tokens.explanation: Elohim — nome hebraico de Deus. Plural de majestade. Denota o único Deus verdadeiro
tokens.explanationEn: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus

tokens.bdb: to make a loud sound (like English 'hum'); by implication, to be in great commotion or tumult, to rage, war, moan, clamor
tokens.kjv: clamorous, concourse, cry aloud, be disquieted, loud, mourn, be moved, make a noise, rage, roar, sound, be troubled, make in tumult, tumultuous, be in an uproar.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to make a loud sound ; by implication
tokens.enLiteralWord: to make a loud sound ; by implication
tokens.explanation: to make a loud sound ; by implication
tokens.explanationEn: to make a loud sound ; by implication

tokens.bdb: to ponder, i.e. (by implication) converse (with oneself, and hence, aloud) or (transitively) utter
tokens.kjv: commune, complain, declare, meditate, muse, pray, speak, talk (with).

tokens.bdb: to shroud, i.e. clothe (whether transitive or reflex.); hence (from the idea of darkness) to languish
tokens.kjv: cover (over), fail, faint, feebler, hide self, be overwhelmed, swoon.

tokens.bdb: wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions)
tokens.kjv: air, anger, blast, breath, [idiom] cool, courage, mind, [idiom] quarter, [idiom] side, spirit(-ual), tempest, [idiom] vain, (whirl-) wind(-y).
tokens.explanation: ruach — espírito, vento, sopro, alento de vida
